claims.claim_en: The EfA strategy generally removes private providers’ opportunity to place competing online services for the same OZG services.
claims.policy_link: Premise for the author’s request for technically feasible, competitive and correctly allocated eWA/EfA implementation.
claims.check_method: Full two-page original read before prior dispositions/peer; primary legal and operator/technical evidence, dates, functional scope and reasonable contextual alternatives checked.
claims.explanation: One mandated reused front end creates a plausible market-displacement concern, but no independent bounded market/competition study or supplier opportunity data establishes the general practical exclusion assertion. Backend vendors’ involvement does not prove independent front-end market access.

claims.claim_en: The federal approach frequently counteracts development of completely end-to-end digital services.
claims.policy_link: Premise for the author’s request for technically feasible, competitive and correctly allocated eWA/EfA implementation.
claims.check_method: Full two-page original read before prior dispositions/peer; primary legal and operator/technical evidence, dates, functional scope and reasonable contextual alternatives checked.
claims.explanation: Technical sources show feasible end-to-end messaging and integration, but do not measure the claimed counteracting causal effect or its frequency across supplier projects.
claims.limits: A working Hamburg service does not refute alleged effects on competing projects; do not confuse capability with realised market outcomes.

claims.claim_en: Federal conduct in recent years has massively hindered manufacturers’ investment decisions.
claims.policy_link: Premise for the author’s request for technically feasible, competitive and correctly allocated eWA/EfA implementation.
claims.check_method: Full two-page original read before prior dispositions/peer; primary legal and operator/technical evidence, dates, functional scope and reasonable contextual alternatives checked.
claims.explanation: No identified investment decisions, projects, counterfactual investments or matched primary company evidence was located. The assertion remains an empirical causal concern, not proven solely by mandated reuse.
claims.limits: Massively has no stated magnitude/denominator. No unsupported-intent or error inference.

claims.claim_en: Document-update annex processes belong to the competent document/pass-law authorities rather than registration competence as such.
claims.policy_link: Premise for the author’s request for technically feasible, competitive and correctly allocated eWA/EfA implementation.
claims.check_method: Full two-page original read before prior dispositions/peer; primary legal and operator/technical evidence, dates, functional scope and reasonable contextual alternatives checked.
claims.explanation: PAuswV19 assigns card-address steps to identity-card authorities; eIDKG6/12/14a assigns eID-card roles. AufenthG71/78(5),(7) assigns residence-document functions to foreigner authorities or other Land-designated authorities. BSI and Dataport distinguish document and registration-side roles.
claims.limits: Functional/legal allocation, not a claim that no municipal body can hold both responsibilities. Section78(7) permits other Land-designated authorities; no physical-separation or mandatory office-visit claim attributed. Author corrects broad draft wording, not demonstrated service impossibility.

exclusions.reason: Exact membership count, address and association self-description are incidental credentials; market-share and historical capability premises separately retained. Approval of nationwide online access and high utility are values. Good service/quality and implementation requirements are expert judgements. Requiring equal quality before future expansion and avoiding unreasonable future connection work are preferences/forecasts; actual interface standards and conditional adaptation-cost mechanism separately checked.

Headings, author/date, board signature and contact layout are provenance/incidental; no delivery inferred. All substantive historical interface/Land/investment allegations and legal role descriptions retained. No normative critique converted into a factual finding.

visual_checks.purpose: Rendered original verifies grouped interface/investment assertions and functional-authority paragraph in full context.

Finite three-formal-external-response batch only; no whole twelve-reply ITKV closure, national prevalence or new reading unit inferred.
